CREATE TABLE section(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, spec TEXT, release TEXT, clause TEXT)
CREATE TABLE section_modified_by(cr TEXT, section_id TEXT)
RAN1.identifier_convention: Document identifiers prefix tdoc:; pack identifiers prefix tdoc:crpack/; section identifiers prefix tdoc:section/ followed by specification-release-clause. Questions request display values rather than prefixed identifiers.
